header.heading: Treasure what lasts forever.
header.description: God has been generous to us in Jesus. Together, we can share that generosity — helping people hear the good news, growing his church, and caring for children in need.

quote.quote: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

intro.heading: Ways you can make a difference
intro.description: This Give Sunday, 6 December, let’s give above and beyond to help more people know Jesus and share his love. Prayerfully consider how you could make a lasting difference through these opportunities. One-off gifts to Ev are in addition to your regular giving.

opportunities.heading: 50 children in Cambodia
opportunities.description: Help give 50 children in Cambodia a brighter future through sponsorship with Tearfund. Share God’s love and be part of a child’s story of hope.

image.alt: Tearfund Cambodia campaign image featuring adults and children

opportunities.heading: Plant — the next church beyond Auckland
opportunities.description: Help take the good news of Jesus beyond Auckland by giving towards the next church plant. Partner in seeing more people find a church family where they can hear about Jesus and grow in faith.

image.alt: People worshipping together at Ev Church

opportunities.heading: Train — Two more pastors to grow us
opportunities.description: Help train two more pastors to serve and grow our church family. Invest in gospel workers who can teach God’s word, care for people, and equip others to serve.

image.alt: Panel discussion at an Ev Church ministry apprenticeship event

opportunities.heading: Grow — Make room for Central's Kids
opportunities.description: Help make room for the children at Central — space to learn about Jesus, build friendships, and grow in faith. Your one-off gift can help us make room for the next generation.

image.alt: Children taking part in an Ev Kids performance

opportunities.heading: Build — Help pay off our North Fit Out
opportunities.description: Help pay off the fit out of our North campus — a place for our church family to gather, welcome others, and hear the good news of Jesus.

image.alt: Exterior of Ev Church North campus at 9–11 Rothwell Avenue, Rosedale

regularGiving.heading: Looking for regular giving?
regularGiving.text: Continue supporting the ongoing life and ministry of Ev through our regular giving page.
